title: Asked by vg-dotfiles-windows: Clone vg-paradigms, vg-deployments and vg-wallpapers; slideshow over vg-wallpapers
body:
Clone vg-paradigms, vg-deployments and vg-wallpapers; slideshow over vg-wallpapers (graft:01a165b4-838d..dc47, from vg-dotfiles-windows)

What was needed:
- vg-dotfiles-windows: If it doesn't already: on every host, clone the repos the machine runs on, beside this flake's own checkout, the way vg-dotfiles-windows now does on Windows (251054d): vaibhav-gopal/vg-paradigms (the baseline, Tend's home), vaibhav-gopal/vg-deployments and vaibhav-gopal/vg-wallpapers. All three are private: over SSH where the host has a key, otherwise HTTPS through gh's credentials. Clone-only: when the folder is missing, never pulled or reset by activation, so work in them is never clobbered (`git pull` is the user's). Project repos are deliberately not cloned: projects start blank. Then, per host with a desktop, run the desktop wallpaper as a slideshow over the vg-wallpapers clone's `wallpapers/` folder: a new image every 30 minutes, shuffled, scaled to fill the screen (cover, cropping rather than letterboxing), with whichever tool each desktop uses (Hyprland on vgkraken, Plasma as its fallback, macOS on vgmacbook if the flake reaches it). The repo's contract: `wallpapers/` holds the images and nothing else; `thumbs/`, `credits.json` and the README gallery are for people, and consumers only read `wallpapers/`. Where these live on each host is yours to pick (e.g. beside this repo's checkout). On Windows they now sit at the top of C:\: C:\vg-dotfiles-windows, C:\vg-paradigms, C:\vg-deployments, C:\vg-wallpapers, and this repo itself moves from C:\vg-workspace\vg-dotfiles to C:\vg-dotfiles. So home/nixos-wsl/modules/default.nix's note that Windows keeps its own clone in Pictures\vg-wallpapers should say C:\vg-wallpapers, and anything in vgwsl2 that reaches the Windows side by path (/mnt/c/vg-workspace/...) should follow the move.

Answer (done): Done in vg-dotfiles 9348eb7 and 3a91d61 (pushed; CI green). Every Nix host clones vg-paradigms, vg-deployments and vg-wallpapers beside its checkout (~/vg-*), clone-only, HTTPS through gh's credentials then SSH with the host's key, never prompting; a clone that can't happen warns and the rebuild carries on (Home/folders). The slideshow over ~/vg-wallpapers/wallpapers changes every 30 minutes, shuffled, filling the screen: hyprpaper 0.8 cycles the folder itself on Hyprland, Plasma's own slideshow is pointed at it at login, GNOME and macOS run a small script (Home/wallpapers). Off on headless hosts and NixOS-WSL, which has no desktop (Windows shows C:\vg-wallpapers; the note in home/nixos-wsl/modules says so). Nothing in this repo reaches /mnt/c/vg-workspace by path; vgwsl2's ~/vg-dotfiles is a hand-made link the user re-points when this repo moves to C:\vg-dotfiles. Not yet run on a desktop.
